name: Muha Meds Disposable (3rd Gen) | Galactic Diesel
description: Galactic Diesel is a pungent, dank indica built for deep relaxation. Its bold, earthy diesel flavor packs a punch, while the heavy, hazy effects ease both mind and body into bliss. Ideal for late nights when you want to drift into the cosmos.
